title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IT Path…
description: A stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in IT Path Solutions Contact Form to Any API versions up to 3.0.7. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.1, indicating high severity with network attack vector, low attack complexity, no privileges required, and user interaction needed. The impact includes confidentiality, integrity, and availability losses. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
